questions.stem: What is the sum of the angles of a quadrilateral?
questions.solution: The sum of the angles of a quadrilateral is always 360°, regardless of its shape, because a quadrilateral can be divided into two triangles, each with an angle sum of 180°. The other options do not match this geometric principle. 180° is the sum for a triangle, 270° and 450° are not valid angle sums for any quadrilateral.

hi.stem: एक चतुर्भुज के कोणों का योग क्या होता है?
hi.solution: एक चतुर्भुज के कोणों का योग हमेशा 360° होता है, चाहे इसका आकार कुछ भी हो, क्योंकि एक चतुर्भुज को दो त्रिभुजों में विभाजित किया जा सकता है, जिनमें प्रत्येक के कोणों का योग 180° होता है। अन्य विकल्प इस ज्यामितीय सिद्धांत के अनुरूप नहीं हैं। 180° एक त्रिभुज के कोणों का योग है, 270° और 450° किसी भी चतुर्भुज के लिए वैध कोण योग नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses standard mathematical terminology used in Hindi textbooks.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of a convex quadrilateral?
choices: All of its sides are equal
All of its angles are equal
All of its internal angles are less than 180°
All of its diagonals are equal
questions.solution: A convex quadrilateral is defined as a quadrilateral where all of its internal angles are less than 180°. This is the key property that differentiates it from a concave quadrilateral. The other options are incorrect because not all quadrilaterals have equal sides or angles, and diagonals are not necessarily equal in all quadrilaterals.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a definition of a parallelogram?
choices: A quadrilateral with one pair of parallel sides
A quadrilateral with all sides equal
A quadrilateral with two pairs of parallel sides
A quadrilateral with all angles equal
questions.solution: The correct answer is a quadrilateral with two pairs of parallel sides. This is the standard definition of a parallelogram. A quadrilateral with one pair of parallel sides is a trapezium. A quadrilateral with all sides equal is a rhombus, and a quadrilateral with all angles equal is a rectangle.

questions.stem: In a quadrilateral ABCD, if AB is parallel to DC and AD is parallel to BC, which of the following is true?
questions.solution: The correct answer is that it is a parallelogram because a quadrilateral with both pairs of opposite sides parallel is defined as a parallelogram. A trapezium has only one pair of parallel sides. A kite has two pairs of adjacent equal sides but not necessarily parallel. A rhombus is a special type of parallelogram with all sides equal, which is not stated here.

hi.stem: एक चतुर्भुज ABCD में, यदि AB, DC के समांतर है और AD, BC के समांतर है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सत्य है?

questions.stem: In a quadrilateral ABCD, if AB is parallel to DC and AB is not equal to DC, and G and H are the midpoints of diagonals AC and BD respectively, what can be said about the line GH?
choices: GH is twice the length of AB
questions.solution: The correct answer is that GH is parallel to AB. In a quadrilateral with AB parallel to DC and AB not equal to DC, the segment connecting the midpoints of the diagonals (GH) is parallel to AB due to the properties of midlines in trapezoids. The other options are incorrect because GH is not necessarily perpendicular to AB, does not always bisect AB, and is not twice the length of AB.

questions.stem: If a quadrilateral is circumscribed around a circle, which of the following is true?
choices: The sum of the lengths of opposite sides is equal
The sum of the lengths of adjacent sides is equal
The product of the lengths of opposite sides is equal
The product of the lengths of adjacent sides is equal
questions.solution: If a quadrilateral is circumscribed around a circle, the sum of the lengths of opposite sides is equal. This is a well-known property of tangential quadrilaterals. The correct option states that the sum of the lengths of opposite sides is equal, which is accurate. The other options are incorrect because they describe properties of different types of quadrilaterals, such as parallelograms or cyclic quadrilaterals. The option about the product of the lengths of opposite sides being equal is incorrect because it applies to cyclic quadrilaterals, not tangential ones.

questions.stem: In a quadrilateral ABCD, if the opposite sides are equal and the diagonals bisect each other, which of the following must be true?
questions.solution: The correct answer is that it is a parallelogram. If the opposite sides of a quadrilateral are equal, it is a parallelogram (converse of Theorem 1(a)). Also, if the diagonals bisect each other, it is a parallelogram (converse of Theorem 1(c)). Both properties together confirm that it is a parallelogram. A square and a rectangle are specific types of parallelograms, but they are not guaranteed here. A rhombus is a parallelogram with all sides equal, which is not stated.

hi.stem: एक चतुर्भुज ABCD में, यदि विपरीत भुजाएँ बराबर हों और विकर्ण एक दूसरे को समद्विभाजित करें, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा अवश्य सत्य होगा?
